description: This Java source file defines a utility helper class 'InlineRequestHelper' for managing inline suggestion requests, creating inline presentations, datasets, and related UI components for Android's autofill inline fill service.

classes.name: InlineRequestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to process inline suggestions requests, create inline presentations, datasets, and related UI components for inline autofill.

methods.name: getInlineSuggestionsRequest
methods.description: Extracts an InlineSuggestionsRequest from a FillRequest if available and valid.

methods.name: getMaxSuggestionCount
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of suggestions to display based on inline request and default max.

methods.name: maybeCreateInlineAuthenticationResponse
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation for authentication purposes if inline suggestions request is present.

methods.name: createInlineDataset
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation dataset with a given value and index for display inline suggestions.

methods.name: createInlineActionDataset
methods.description: Creates a Dataset for inline action, including an inline presentation with an icon and authentication intent.

methods.name: createInlineAction
methods.description: Creates an InlinePresentation representing an inline action with an icon.

methods.name: createSlice
methods.description: Constructs a Slice with title, subtitle, icons, and attribution PendingIntent.

methods.name: createAttribution
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent for attribution dialog with a message.
